{
  "c": "1:S_i4H|# Changelog
2:47DEQ|
3:_CLAZ|Notable changes to Pit are documented here. GitHub release notes remain the authoritative detailed record for each tagged release.
4:47DEQ|
5:HaQuG|## [Unreleased]
6:47DEQ|
7:LhaSL|### Added
8:47DEQ|
9:3kVgL|- `npm.ci({ includeDev?, ignoreScripts? })` runs `npm ci`, which `npm.install` could not (#383). `includeDev: false` adds `--omit=dev`; `true` adds `--include=dev`.
10:MhYMe|- Git branch and sync globals (#383): `git.switchBranch` (`git switch`; `switch` is a reserved word), `git.fetch`, `git.pull`, `git.revParse` (`git rev-parse`), and `git.lsRemote` (`git ls-remote`). Each takes an argument array and process options like the other `git.*` functions, and its result summary names the branch switched to, `up to date`, the resolved revision, or the ref count.
11:Pc38f|- Programs can call `atob` and `btoa`, which the sandbox provided but its type definitions omitted (#383).
12:w-jL0|- Repository maintainer functions: `delivery.openPullRequest` creates a branch, commits and pushes through `delivery.commit`, and opens the pull request; `pr.merge({ sync: true })` merges, then switches to the base branch and fast-forwards it (#383).
13:47DEQ|
14:W4hhh|### Changed
15:47DEQ|
16:yncCI|- Repository maintainer functions: `ci.waitForRun`, `ci.waitForCommit`, and `pr.waitForChecks` return `outcome: "pending"` with a hint to call again when they time out, instead of throwing (#383). `ci.waitForRun` and `ci.waitForCommit` results always carry `outcome` and `conclusion`.
17:ZeiLI|- `npm.run(script, options)` takes process options second when the script has no args (#383); `npm.run(script, args, options)` still works.
18:6YIMy|- `workspace.edit` and batch edits accept a mapped `PitEditChange[]` and anchors typed as plain `string` (#383). Edit already checked at runtime that changes are non-empty and anchors match the file. The tool description shows a batch edit's `changes: { revision, changes: [...] }` shape.
19:47DEQ|
20:RTD6h|## [0.36.6] - 2026-11-14
21:47DEQ|
22:W4hhh|### Changed
23:47DEQ|
24:MJPZq|- The `typescript` tool's guidelines tell the model to plan each step before calling (#375): gather every read, search, and probe a step needs in one program, and make all its edits to different files in one, since each tool call is a round trip that resends the context. Sessions that read one file per call, then edit one file per call, should need fewer turns.
25:47DEQ|
26:PEsni|## [0.36.5] - 2026-11-14
27:47DEQ|
28:r-drj|### Fixed
29:47DEQ|
30:qPpIj|- The `typescript` tool's `present` field handles every stored call and result a host passes it (#372). A call with no label and blank code gets a title (its `functionId`, or `typescript`) instead of an empty one, which pi-action rejected. A `saveOnly` result without a saved name shows the `functionId` or the declared function's name, or no summary, instead of `saved undefined`. Results without Pit's details, such as those pi-durable writes itself, and arguments whose `code` isn't a string, are shown by their text instead of throwing.
31:47DEQ|
32:W4hhh|### Changed
33:47DEQ|
34:UPIxS|- A call that asked a question is summarized as `asked: <title>` in the host's log, which says why the turn ended.
35:47DEQ|
36:luW8u|## [0.36.4] - 2026-11-14
37:47DEQ|
38:LhaSL|### Added
39:47DEQ|
40:fF-Ku|- On pi-durable hosts, the `typescript` tool has a `present` field that tells hosts such as pi-action how to show its calls in a log (#372): the label as the title, the program without its `// @pit:` header and its `params`, the functions it injected as the result's summary, and the returned value as readable text, with strings such as file contents and command output as they are instead of escaped JSON. pi-action no longer needs to parse Pit's header itself. See [pi-durable hosts](docs/durable.md#tools-the-model-sees).
41:47DEQ|
42:ZGqfj|## [0.36.3] - 2026-11-14
43:47DEQ|
44:r-drj|### Fixed
45:47DEQ|
46:2P18h|- A `params` string sent as a JSON string literal, with its quotes and `\n` escapes, reaches the program decoded, also when the program declares a string input (#368). Such a program got the encoded text, so a PR body passed to `gh pr create --body` started with `"` and showed `\n` instead of line breaks. A quoted string that is not valid JSON is passed through unchanged.
47:47DEQ|
48:DFM0i|## [0.36.2] - 2026-11-13
49:47DEQ|
50:LhaSL|### Added
51:47DEQ|
52:NjwXp|- `workspace.viewImage` works on pi-durable hosts such as pi-action, with the limits it has on Pi, and the image reaches the model (#365). The new `images` option of `createPitDurableExtension` takes an `ImageProcessor`, such as `createNodePhotonImages()` from `@earendil-works/pi-durable/images/node`, to resize and convert images to the model's limits; without one, PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP images within the byte limit attach as they are. See [Images](docs/durable.md#images).
53:47DEQ|
54:r-drj|### Fixed
55:47DEQ|
56:Uw5p9|- On pi-durable hosts, images that `tools.*` calls return are attached to the result instead of reported as omitted, also from tools that declare an output schema, whose images were dropped without notice.
57:47DEQ|
58:Tgdvj|## [0.36.1] - 2026-11-13
59:47DEQ|
60:W4hhh|### Changed",
